title: Caching Strategies
description: Deep dive into React Query caching mechanisms, cache configuration, and invalidation strategies.
longDescription: This module covers advanced caching strategies in React Query including cache time configuration, garbage collection, stale-while-revalidate behavior, background refetching, cache invalidation patterns, and how to tune cache settings for different application needs.
whatYouLearn: Configure cacheTime and staleTime for optimal performance
Understand garbage collection and when queries are removed from cache
Implement cache invalidation strategies with queryClient.invalidateQueries
Control background refetching behavior with refetchInterval and refetchOnWindowFocus
Persist cache across sessions with persistence plugins
